.github/workflows/engine-render.yml.text: # freshly recomputed engine outputs (regime/latest.json was just
# updated by engine.run above).  O(50ms) — negligible on the render
# budget.  Resilient: a failure keeps the last committed world_state
# and never blocks the render.
# git add site/ in the commit step below does NOT cover data/neuralweb/;
# the express lane commits site/ only, so world_state.json is NOT
# committed here — it is a working-tree side-effect that gets discarded
# exactly like the other data/ writes (regime_history, ledger appends).
# The nightly daily.yml run recomputes and commits it under data/.
# This step exists so world_state is FRESH in memory for any builder
# that reads it during the render (the builders run after this step and
# read data/neuralweb/world_state.json from the working tree).
run: python -m scripts.build_world_state || echo "::warning::build_world_state failed (non-fatal) — keeping last committed world_state"
- name: build mastermind context (NW bridge)
if: always()
# NW → Mastermind bridge W1: compile data/neuralweb/mastermind_context.json and
# COMMITTED artifact on disk (the last daily's write); the page renders the last
# nightly's cycle data rather than a fresh recompute — matching the express lane's
# stated contract ("re-render from committed data"). Call AFTER band so cl_baskets
# has completed. Additive (returns 0 on any failure), so it can never break the deploy.
# Ledger-safe: this lane's commit step is `git add site/` ONLY (engine-render.yml:340),
# so data/sector_central/calls.parquet is discarded; the nightly daily.yml run is the
# sole advancer of that forward ledger.
central() { run_py "US sector central intelligence (build_sector_central)" scripts.build_sector_central; }
band() {
local ART="$RUNNER_TEMP/band"; rm -rf "$ART"; mkdir -p "$ART"
brun() {
local slug="$1" label="$2" mod="$3"; shift 3
local t0 t1 rc
t0=$(date +%s)
{ echo "$label"; python -m "$mod" "$@" 2>&1; } > "$ART/$slug.log"; rc=$?
python3 scripts/check_ms_board_coherence.py --heal-from HEAD || true
exit 1
- name: inject data-base shim (site-wide; a re-render would strip it otherwise)
run: python -m scripts.inject_data_base || echo "data-base shim inject skipped (additive)"
- name: commit rendered site (site/ ONLY — never data/, so every ledger stays pristine)
if: always()
run: |
git config user.name "dashboard-bot"
git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
# ONLY site/ — never data/ or reports/. engine.run + the builders touch data/ in the
# working tree (regime recompute, ledger appends, cache writes); committing NONE of it
# keeps the nightly the single advancer of every forward-accountability ledger.
git add site/
git add -f site/stockbrief 2>/dev/null || true
if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "no rendered-site changes to commit"; exit 0; fi
git commit -m "engine-render: regime recompute + re-render $(date -u +%F) (scope=${{ github.event.inputs.scope || 'all' }})"
# --autostash: we commit site/ ONLY, leaving the render's throwaway data/ writes
# unstaged; a plain `pull --rebase` refuses on a dirty tree and silently failed
# EVERY push. Autostash parks them, rebases, restores. This push is the only path
# to the live site (VPS serves committed main; no Pages-artifact fallback).
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
# pre-sync collision sweep (render.yml / #2252): a mid-run commit on origin/main can
# TRACK a path this job wrote as an UNTRACKED side-effect — the rebase checkout then
# refuses ("untracked working tree files would be overwritten") and --autostash can't
git fetch origin main || true
comm -12 <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | LC_ALL=C sort) \
<(git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main | LC_ALL=C sort) \
| while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f -- "$f" || true; done
if git pull --rebase --autostash -X theirs origin main; then
# post-rebase template↔site re-sync (ui.template_site_sync). -X theirs can
# resurrect this run's checkout-time template copies over a reword that merged
# MID-RENDER: 2026-07-07 incident — run 28835838497 (110 min, checkout
# 9208ef4920) pushed 2ae709f9f0, whose site/sector_cycles.js was byte-identical
# to the CHECKOUT-TIME template blob, reverting #1793's de-escalation merged
# 20 min earlier. templates/ is now fresh post-rebase main — re-copy the
# plain-copy page assets from it and fold any delta into a follow-up commit.
python -m scripts.check_template_site_sync --fix || true
# ms-board coherence guard (ui.ms_board_coherence): -X theirs resolves whole
# conflict REGIONS toward this run's replayed render, so racing another
# mid-render lane can stitch a hybrid Market State board — 2026-07-07 commit
# origin/main (coherent, at most one render old).
python3 scripts/check_ms_board_coherence.py --heal-from origin/main \
|| echo "::warning::ms-board coherence heal incomplete (incoherent board may predate this run)"
if ! git diff --quiet -- site/; then
git add site/ && git commit -m "render-sync: post-rebase guards (template re-copy + ms-board coherence)" \
|| echo "::warning::render-sync commit failed (non-fatal — pages publish gate backstops divergence)"
fi
if git push; then echo "pushed engine-rendered site on attempt $i"; exit 0; fi
fi
git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
echo "engine-render push attempt $i failed (rebase/race); re-syncing"; sleep $((i * 7))
done
echo "::warning::could not push engine-rendered site after 5 attempts — the next render or the nightly will re-land it"
